seatKey.description: floor|department|id when the seat has an optional id (e.g. 1F|optics|optics-1), otherwise floor|department|title.

working.description: true = person at desk (working); false = person in break area (not working).

source.description: mock = data/status.mock.json; live = written by the local tools/status-bridge (grokbot status --json).

avatarUrl.description: Optional avatar image URL, masked by avatarShape. Without an image, render a colored shape with capsule eyes. A placeholder slot, not an official live avatar source.

avatarShape.description: Head shape: wedge = rounded right-pointing triangle; teardrop = drop; hex = hexagon; blob = circle; cloud = multi-lobed cloud; round = circle; square = square. Default: blob.

avatarColor.description: Shape fill (CSS color); defaults to department color.

StatusRecord.description: Missing or unknown records count as not working. Optional avatar fields may also be set on org.json seats; status values override seat values.
